mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in federal funds rate signals a labor market slowdown coupled with monetary easing, which typically generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
regime_hint: labor market slowdown with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime characterized by rising housing starts, consumer spending growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as housing boom cycle (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market, which correlates with strong corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth exceeds 100,000 jobs, it signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 100k in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in industrial production and housing starts indicates expanding economic activity, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months AND HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over 3 years is below 0.03.
